Question: Which statement about the inscribed angle theorem is correct?

Choices.A: An inscribed angle equals the central angle subtending the same arc.
Choices.B: All inscribed angles subtending the same chord are equal.
Choices.C: Inscribed angles subtending the same arc or equal arcs are equal.

Solution: An inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc. Inscribed angles subtending the same chord may lie on opposite sides of the chord and be supplementary, so they are not necessarily equal. Inscribed angles subtending the same arc or equal arcs are equal.
